summary: A standard clickable button, available in several visual styles like primary, ghost, and icon-only.
description: A button with multiple types and three sizes.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The button's label, will be overridden by slotted content.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The button type. Options: default, primary, destructive, icon, icon ghost, ghost, split (plus icon neutral/neutral seen in Figma Code Connect).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The button size. Options: default, small, large.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The button's title attribute, used in shadow DOM and therefore not as an attribute on moz-button.

attributes.name: tooltipText
attributes.description: Set the title property; the title attribute will be used first.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The button's aria-label attribute, used in shadow DOM and therefore not as an attribute on moz-button.

attributes.name: ariaHasPopup
attributes.description: The button's aria-haspopup attribute, indicates a popup element can be triggered by the button.

attributes.name: ariaExpanded
attributes.description: The button's aria-expanded attribute, indicates whether the controlled elements are displayed or hidden.

attributes.name: ariaPressed
attributes.description: The button's aria-pressed attribute, used in shadow DOM and therefore not as an attribute on moz-button.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: Path to the icon that should be displayed in the button.

attributes.name: attention
attributes.description: Show a dot notification on the button if true.

attributes.name: iconPosition
attributes.description: The icon's position relative to the button label. Options: start, end.

attributes.name: menuId
attributes.description: A CSS selector string that identifies the associated panel-list menu element controlled by the button.

attributes.name: parentDisabled
attributes.description: When the parent of this component is disabled.

attributes.name: accessKey
attributes.description: Internal, maps the accesskey attribute to the accessKey JS property (mapped, not in the top JSDoc block but declared in static properties).

attributes.name: hasVisibleLabel
attributes.description: Internal, tracks whether or not the button has a visible label (state property, not a real attribute).

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The button's content, overrides label property.

cssProperties.name: --button-outer-padding-inline
cssProperties.description: Used to set the outer inline padding of toolbar style buttons.

cssProperties.name: --button-outer-padding-block
cssProperties.description: Used to set the outer block padding of toolbar style buttons.

cssProperties.name: --button-outer-padding-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Used to set the outer inline-start padding of toolbar style buttons.

cssProperties.name: --button-outer-padding-inline-end
cssProperties.description: Used to set the outer inline-end padding of toolbar style buttons.

cssProperties.name: --button-outer-padding-block-start
cssProperties.description: Used to set the outer block-start padding of toolbar style buttons.

cssProperties.name: --button-outer-padding-block-end
cssProperties.description: Used to set the outer block-end padding of toolbar style buttons.

cssParts.name: chevron-button
cssParts.description: The dropdown-opening chevron on a split-type button.
